text:
Carmen: Quick run-before-live note: mic stack on stage B is noisy, plan to swap to wireless lapel right before roadmap. Can ops confirm mute-safety and recorder continuity?
Zoe: Copy. I'll cue the mic swap and hold the slide transition until you give go. Switching audio feed to backup mesa-2 during swap.
OpsBot: audio-route switched to mesa-2 :white_check_mark: 
Diego: Heads-up: demo timing shifted by ~40s in the dry run. Recommend we move the demo to after Q&A OR add a 30s buffer after roadmap. Thoughts?
Carmen: Let's keep demo after roadmap but add a 30s buffer and call out the change at start. Zoe, can you patch the slide notes so presenters know about the buffer?
Zoe: Done. Slide 1 notes now say: "Start: announce demo after roadmap +30s buffer". Uploaded v3 deck: https://drive/allhands/decks/ah-v3.pptx
Mia (CEO): Good plan. We'll mention the reorder in the intro and reserve 6 mins for customer questions at the end. Also we'll mark Dedicated autoscaler as "planned (Q2 design)" on the roadmap slide.
Carmen: Ops, please start fallback recorder and confirm upload hook.
Zoe: Kicking off local recorder now:
```
recctl capture --session ah-2026-03-23 --out /recs/allhands-2026-03-23-fallback.mp4 --mode continuous
```
RecorderBot: recording started (id: rb-7721)
OpsBot: ingest monitor OK. no frame drops in last 60s.
Diego: I'll move captions resync to happen immediately after roadmap, + will pre-warn the captioner to watch for presenter overlap.
Carmen: Also flag for Qs: Dedicated pricing flexibility (monthly vs annual), Dedicated latency SLA, and Private deployment onboarding time. Prioritize pricing.
Mia (CEO): Agreed. Product please have someone ready to answer pricing/commit questions in the Q&A slot. We'll take top 3 live.
Zoe: Mic swap complete, levels look good. Ready to go in 30s.
Carmen: Thanks. If anyone sees audio artifacts, post here and I'll cut to backup.
Diego: Feed stable. captions resynced.
RecorderBot: upload will start after session and attach to INF-701.
Zoe: Post-meeting checklist: Recorder to upload raw file + attach to INF ticket, Product to send pricing FAQ doc, Comms to clip 8-10m highlight.
Carmen: Noted. Diego, can you trim the first 8 minutes and surface the demo clip after the meeting?
Diego: Yep, will export and ping thread with link.
Mia (CEO): Thanks everyone, appreciate the quick ops & product coordination. We'll take the prioritized Qs at the end.
Carmen: Moving to live now. Good luck all :slightly_smiling_face:
